sloka: रुरोध दुःखं जनयन्नन्तःपुर इव स्त्रियः ।तस्मात्त्वां शरणं प्राप्ता वायुनोहता वयम् ।। ७.३५.५६ ॥
transliteration: rurodha duḥkhaṁ janayannantaḥpura iva striyaḥ ।tasmāttvāṁ śaraṇaṁ prāptā vāyunohatā vayam ।। 7.35.56 ॥

translations.english: "He has obstructed us, causing sorrow, just as women are confined in a harem; therefore, we, afflicted by Vayu, have sought refuge in you."
